title: SkyReimagined
description: Changes sky color depending on biome
body:
# **SkyReimagined**

This datapack is meant to add vibrant colorful sky to your world, especially if you don't want to use polytone or simmilar mods.

## SCREENSHOTS
Check out [gallery](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skyreimagined/gallery) for more screenshots

![Cherry grove](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/L4yOC2uw/images/9a07475fbc1b5eaadafe697e8d5663b7c32c2003_350.webp) ![Savanna](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/L4yOC2uw/images/157c0367f5c0b7b5d6a978dd4dc0f6bc5cefac69_350.webp)

![Mangrove swamp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/L4yOC2uw/images/6e2476fb4c0c686d8c67fee98fcf06fd9ba5d27b_350.webp) ![Messa](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/L4yOC2uw/images/1bc509364718ca0d0c591171df8f4b5565910d86_350.webp)



### **NOTES**
- You need to apply this datapack to every world you want to use it in.
- You are not able to use this datapack on servers.
